headings.title: Creation of public school retirement system as body corporate
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the public school retirement system as a body corporate with corporate powers and legal seat.

headings.title: Vesting of system administration in board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Vests general administration and operational responsibility of the retirement system in a seven-member board of trustees.

headings.title: Terms of office and staggered elections of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Sets four-year terms of office for appointed and elected trustees commencing on the first day of July.

headings.title: Qualifications of governor-appointed board trustees
headings.reviewNote: Requires governor-appointed trustees to reside in covered school districts without being district or state employees.

headings.title: Management and conduct of trustee elections by board
headings.reviewNote: Directs the board of trustees to arrange, manage, and conduct all elections for elected trustee positions.

headings.title: Filling of board of trustees vacancies for unexpired terms
headings.reviewNote: Provides that trustee vacancies shall be filled for unexpired terms in the same manner as original selections.

headings.title: Trustee service without compensation and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that trustees serve without compensation but receive reimbursement for necessary official expenses.

headings.title: Gubernatorial commission and trustee constitutional oath of office
headings.reviewNote: Requires each trustee to receive a gubernatorial commission and take a constitutional oath of office before serving.

headings.title: Voting rights of trustees and four-vote decision rule
headings.reviewNote: Grants each trustee one vote and requires four concurring votes for any decision by the board of trustees.

headings.title: Election of chairman and employment of executive director
headings.reviewNote: Directs trustees to elect a chairman and employ a full-time executive director and administrative staff.

headings.title: Employment of consulting actuary as technical advisor
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board of trustees to employ an actuary as technical advisor on system operations.

headings.title: Annual actuarial valuation of system assets and liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Directs the actuary to perform annual valuations of system assets and liabilities using demographic and financial data.

headings.title: Five-year actuarial experience investigation and mortality tables
headings.reviewNote: Mandates comprehensive actuarial experience investigations at least once every five years to update mortality tables.

headings.title: Board authority to adopt administrative rules and regulations
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the board of trustees to formulate and adopt rules and regulations governing its proceedings and business.

headings.title: Board authority over employment and benefits and Cole County appeals
headings.reviewNote: Vests the board with authority to decide questions of covered employment, benefits, and contributions, with certified-mail notice and de novo appeal within thirty days to the Cole County circuit court under section 536.150 standards.

headings.title: Maintenance of public records and annual financial report
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to maintain public proceedings records and publish an audited comprehensive annual financial report.

headings.title: Individual member accounts, valuation data, and record confidentiality
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining individual member earnings/contribution/interest accounts and actuarial data, and makes individually identifiable member, retiree, beneficiary, and survivor information confidential (except executive director and board employee salaries and benefits).

headings.title: Semi-annual regular board meetings and special sessions
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to meet regularly at least twice per year and hold special meetings as designated by rules.

headings.title: Jefferson City headquarters and exclusive Cole County venue
headings.reviewNote: Locates system headquarters in Jefferson City paid from system funds and requires all suits or proceedings against the board, its members or employees, or PSRS/PEERS to be brought in Cole County.

headings.title: Appointment of legal counsel or use of attorney general
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to appoint legal counsel or request legal representation from the state attorney general.

headings.title: Surety bond requirements for executive director
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board of trustees to arrange adequate surety bonds covering the executive director, approved by the board and deposited with the secretary of state.

headings.title: Annual independent financial audit by certified public accountants
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual financial audits of system accounts and records conducted by an independent CPA firm.

headings.title: Interest penalty on delinquent employer contribution payments
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board rules imposing interest charges on delinquent employer contributions up to the actuarial rate.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 23 editorial headings for 169.020 establishing PSRS, board of trustees governance, actuarial duties, confidentiality, Cole County venue, audits, and delinquent contribution interest.

headings.title: Petition for transfer from urban district system to state system
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes two-thirds of teachers in a district over 75,000 with a local retirement system to petition for transfer to PSRS upon approval by the local system board and board of education, with local discontinuance set within one year.

headings.title: Transfer of teacher accumulated contributions and equal district match
headings.reviewNote: Requires the local system before discontinuance to transfer each teacher's accumulated contributions (capped at state system equivalent) plus an equal local board contribution to PSRS, refunding any excess to the teacher.

headings.title: Equalization payments, payroll withholding, and reduced credit
headings.reviewNote: Requires additional local transfers to equalize benefits with original PSRS members, authorizes monthly payroll withholding for teacher equalization amounts, and limits credit to membership service paid if full payment is not made.

headings.title: Continuation of retired teacher benefits and age-69 reserve funding
headings.reviewNote: Entitles previously retired local teachers to continue receiving the same monthly benefits from PSRS upon local funding of reserves for retirees and active age-69 teachers (or actuarial contribution-rate stabilization payment in districts of at least 200,000).

headings.title: Lump-sum or installment payment schedule and interest rates
headings.reviewNote: Permits local school boards to pay required amounts in a lump sum or installments over ten years at two percent interest, or up to twenty-five years at PSRS average investment return in districts of at least 200,000.

headings.title: Withdrawal and settlement for non-teachers in districts of 75,000 to 100,000
headings.reviewNote: Provides for two-thirds vote withdrawal with double-account payout for active non-teachers and mutually agreed buyouts for retired non-teachers in districts over 75,000 and under 100,000, with dissolution date fixed locally.

headings.title: Continuation of local system for non-teachers in districts of 200,000 or more
headings.reviewNote: Continues the local system for non-certificated employees in districts of at least 200,000 with withdrawal and new-hire opt-out rights until obligations end, and requires the local system or board to make up any benefit shortfall for transferred certificated teachers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.021 governing petitions and asset transfers from urban local teacher systems to PSRS, benefit equalization, retiree continuation, installment payments, and non-teacher dissolution/continuation rules.

headings.title: Equal contribution obligations for members and employers
headings.reviewNote: Requires retirement funding through equal matching contributions paid by covered employees and school district employers.

headings.title: Annual transmission of contributions and civil and misdemeanor penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires employers each school year to transmit twice the deductible amount, imposes individual civil liability for twice the withheld amount, and makes willful refusal a misdemeanor fined $25 to $200 per day.

headings.title: Payroll deductions, pre-1996 medical benefits, and IRC 401(a)(17) cap
headings.reviewNote: Requires collecting member contributions via payroll deductions (except under section 104.342), deems pre-February 20, 1996 medical-benefit salary treatments compliant without refund/adjustment, and applies IRC Section 401(a)(17) limits effective December 31, 1995.

headings.title: Annual actuarial determination and certification of contribution rate
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to fix and certify annual contribution rates based on actuarial recommendations, subject to statutory caps.

headings.title: Deemed employee consent to payroll deductions and salary discharge
headings.reviewNote: Deems every teacher or employee to consent to statutory payroll deductions and makes payment of salary less deductions a full discharge of salary claims except as to sections 169.010 to 169.141 benefits.

headings.title: Restriction on legislative benefit increases after July 1, 2003
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits enacting legislation after July 1, 2003, increasing PSRS benefits above what a 10.5 percent contribution rate can fund, except legislation extending election deadlines under section 169.070(1)(3) to (8).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 editorial headings for 169.030 governing equal contributions, annual transmission and civil/criminal penalties, payroll deductions and IRC 401(a)(17) limits, actuarial rate setting, deemed consent, and post-July 1, 2003 benefit increase limits.

headings.title: Ownership and control of retirement system funds by board
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all funds belong to the retirement system and are under exclusive investment control of trustees.

headings.title: Prudent person investment standard and delegation to SEC counselors
headings.reviewNote: Requires investing excess funds under section 105.688 prudent-person standards, permits delegation to SEC-registered investment advisors, and shields board members acting in good faith with prudent care from liability.

headings.title: Creation of joint PSRS and PEERS investment fund account
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a combined PSRS/PEERS investment fund account with separate accounting and reporting, grants rulemaking authority, and includes a chapter 536 nonseverability clause for rules after August 28, 2009.

headings.title: Board member conflict bans and nominee, bearer, or book-entry holding
headings.reviewNote: Bars board members from having interests in or profiting from investment transactions, and authorizes holding securities via custodians, nominees, bearer/book-entry form, central depositories, or Federal Reserve book-entry systems.

headings.title: Appointment of bank or trust company as investment custodian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to designate a qualified bank or trust company as depository, custodian, and investment intermediary.

headings.title: Mandatory payment of allowances by electronic funds transfer
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of retirement allowances and periodic benefits by electronic funds transfer unless board waives.

headings.title: Closed board meetings for deliberations on investment transactions
headings.reviewNote: Permits closed meetings under Sunshine Law to deliberate on investment purchases or sales where disclosure damages value.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.040 governing PSRS fund ownership, prudent-person investment and counselor delegation, combined PSRS/PEERS investment account, trustee conflicts and nominee holding, bank depository, EFT payments, and closed investment meetings.

headings.title: Mandatory membership for public school teachers and employees
headings.reviewNote: Makes all covered employees members by virtue of employment (except under section 104.342) and excludes individuals qualifying and treated as common-law independent contractors.

headings.title: Prior service credit for employment rendered before system creation
headings.reviewNote: Permits first-year members to claim up to thirty years of prior Missouri service or wartime Armed Forces service (if inducted while a Missouri teacher) upon verified filing with the board.

headings.title: Bar on late prior service credit and military, study, and return exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Bars prior service credit for those joining after the first operative year except under subsection 5, for wartime Armed Forces service or educational attendance within specified windows, or for pre-August 1, 1945 teachers meeting return-to-teaching rules.

headings.title: Events terminating membership in public school retirement system
headings.reviewNote: Terminates membership upon five consecutive school years without earning membership credit, death, withdrawal of contributions, or retirement.

headings.title: Forfeiture and reinstatement of service upon withdrawal or refund
headings.reviewNote: Forfeits creditable service upon withdrawal or refund, permits full or partial reinstatement upon returning to membership by repaying withdrawn contributions with interest prior to membership termination, and allows disability allowance deductions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.050 governing mandatory PSRS membership and independent contractor exclusion, prior service claims, post-first-year prior service exceptions, membership termination, and service forfeiture/reinstatement.

headings.title: Creditable service for employer-assigned leave at fifty percent pay
headings.reviewNote: Permits a member assigned to a leave of absence with contract compensation of at least fifty percent of regular pay to acquire creditable service and retain membership by remitting full employee and employer matching contributions based on full regular pay.

headings.title: Pro rata PSRS coverage election for part-time DESE employees
headings.reviewNote: Permits DESE employees covered by PSRS as of August 28, 1993, who move without termination to part-time DESE positions of at least twenty hours per week to elect pro rata PSRS coverage within ninety days, barring dual public retirement credit.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.055 governing creditable service during paid leaves of absence at fifty percent or more pay and pro rata PSRS coverage elections for part-time DESE employees.

headings.title: Eligibility, cost calculation, recalculation, and rules for purchases
headings.reviewNote: Requires one year of covered service plus subsequent covered employment, sets purchase cost formulas (including post-January 1, 2006 recalculation and June 30, 2006 irrevocable option), allows IRC 415 limits and 1/10-year increments, and includes a chapter 536 nonseverability clause.

headings.title: Maximum limitation on purchased service credit
headings.reviewNote: Limits total service credit purchased under section to member's actual accrued Missouri public school service credit.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for in-state or out-of-state public education service
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing equivalent credit for regular employment of at least twenty hours per week by a public school district, community college, college, or university inside or outside Missouri.

headings.title: Purchase of membership credit for honorable military service
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to purchase retirement service credit for periods of active duty service in the United States Armed Forces.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for unpaid maternity or paternity leave
headings.reviewNote: Allows members to purchase retirement credit for periods of approved unpaid maternity or paternity leave.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit by certified vocational-technical teachers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified vocational-technical instructors to purchase credit for required trade and occupational experience.

headings.title: Purchase of forfeited service credit from PEERS system
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to purchase and transfer previously forfeited nonteacher service credit from PEERS into PSRS.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for leave with nonprofit education support entities
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing credit for regular employment of twenty or more hours per week while on leave from a section 169.010 employer for a nonprofit corporation or agency whose primary purpose is education support or research.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for private school, college, or university service
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing equivalent credit for regular employment of at least twenty hours per week by a private school, community college, college, or university inside or outside Missouri.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for nonfederal public employment
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing equivalent creditable service for regular nonfederal public employment of at least twenty hours per week, subject to this section.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for employment covered by Social Security
headings.reviewNote: Allows members age eighteen or older to purchase service credit for prior regular employment covered by Social Security.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 11 editorial headings for 169.056 governing PSRS service purchase terms/recalculation, purchase caps, and eligible prior public education, military, parental leave, vo-tech, PEERS, nonprofit leave, private education, nonfederal public, and Social Security employment.

headings.title: Eligibility for full and actuarially reduced service retirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes full retirement at age sixty with five years, rule of eighty, age fifty-five with twenty-five years, or thirty years any age, and actuarially reduced retirement with twenty-five years or at age fifty-five with five to fewer than twenty-five years.

headings.title: Disability retirement eligibility for disabled members with five years' service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes disability retirement for members with five or more years' creditable service upon permanent incapacity certification.

headings.title: Disability standard, periodic re-examinations, and Social Security offset
headings.reviewNote: Defines permanent disability based on reports of two or more board-selected physicians, permits periodic re-examinations until age sixty with termination upon recovery, and treats age-55/25-year disability recipients as normal retirees under 20 CFR 404.408.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.060 governing full and actuarially reduced service retirement eligibility, disability retirement eligibility, and disability definition, re-examinations, and Social Security offset treatment.

headings.title: Normal retirement allowance calculation formula and multipliers
headings.reviewNote: Calculates annual normal pension by multiplying final average salary by years of creditable service and statutory multiplier.

headings.title: Alternative allowance formula for members age sixty on September 28, 1975
headings.reviewNote: Permits a member age sixty or older on September 28, 1975, to elect an alternative formula based on sixty cents plus 1.5 percent per membership year, prior service credit, and a monthly age-60-to-65 enhancement.

headings.title: Optional survivor plans (options 2 to 6) and pre-retirement death elections
headings.reviewNote: Permits electing reduced actuarial equivalent benefits under options 2 through 6 (with pop-up for options 2–4 and 120/60-month guarantees for options 5–6), and governs pre-retirement death option 2 elections.

headings.title: Refund of excess accumulated contributions upon death after retirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying any excess of accumulated contributions over total retirement or disability allowances paid before death (including after option 2, 3, or 4 beneficiary death) in statutory precedence order.

headings.title: Payment of final benefit when financial institution cannot accept payment
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of final benefit(s) to the beneficiary or in statutory precedence order when a deceased member's or beneficiary's financial institution is unable to accept the final payment.

headings.title: Death benefit options for members dying prior to retirement
headings.reviewNote: Governs survivor benefit choices and contribution refunds when an active member dies prior to service retirement.

headings.title: Refund of accumulated contributions upon permanent termination of service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes refund of accumulated contributions with interest upon member's permanent separation from covered teaching.

headings.title: Deferred retirement allowance for vested members upon separation
headings.reviewNote: Permits members separating with five or more years of service to leave contributions and receive deferred retirement at age sixty.

headings.title: Disability retirement allowance computation formula
headings.reviewNote: Calculates disability retirement allowance at nine-tenths of normal service allowance based on projected service.

headings.title: Contribution rate adjustments for members covered by federal Social Security
headings.reviewNote: Adjusts contribution rates and benefit calculations for members whose positions are covered by federal Social Security taxes.

headings.title: Benefit modifications for members with state-paid Social Security taxes
headings.reviewNote: Governs retirement allowance adjustments for members for whom state or local funds paid federal Old Age taxes.

headings.title: Supplemental benefit adjustments for pre-1972 retired members
headings.reviewNote: Grants a two-percent-per-year-retired increase commencing January 1976 for pre-September 1, 1972 retirees or option 1/2 beneficiaries without reducing section 169.580 or 169.585 compensation; source footnote notes section 169.580 was repealed by H.B. 1608, 2012.

headings.title: Annual cost-of-living allowance increases based on consumer price index
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to grant annual cost-of-living benefit increases when consumer price index rises two percent or more.

headings.title: Discretionary COLA reduction when cost of living falls below initial level
headings.reviewNote: Permits the board to reduce subsection 13 increases if the cost of living falls below its level at the time of the member's first increase, not exceeding total post-December 31, 1976 increases.

headings.title: Spousal notification certification on retirement applications
headings.reviewNote: Requires retirement application to include sworn certification confirming member's spouse was notified of election.

headings.title: Survivor option adjustments for pre-1983 retired members
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes benefit adjustments for members who retired under option 1 or 2 prior to September 28, 1983.

headings.title: Federal Internal Revenue Code Section 415 benefit limitations
headings.reviewNote: Limits retirement benefits to maximum ceilings imposed by Section 415 of the federal Internal Revenue Code.

headings.title: Special consultant appointment and minimum monthly benefits by service
headings.reviewNote: Appoints persons retired before, on, or after May 26, 1994, as special consultants and guarantees minimum monthly benefits of $1,200 (30+ yrs), $1,000 (25–<30 yrs), $800 (20–<25 yrs), or $600 (15–<20 yrs), subject to actuarial option adjustments.

headings.title: Special consultant monthly increase for pre-1994 retirees and pre-1999 survivors
headings.reviewNote: Appoints pre-May 26, 1994 retirees (beginning Sept. 1, 1996) and designated beneficiaries of such retirees deceased prior to July 1, 1999 (beginning Sept. 1, 1999) as special consultants with the lesser of $60 or $2 per service year added to monthly annuities.

headings.title: Employment of pre-1998 retired members as special consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 1998, as special consultants entitled to supplemental monthly compensation.

headings.title: Special consultant appointment and five-thousand-dollar death benefit
headings.reviewNote: Appoints all retired members as special consultants on education, retirement, and aging, providing a five-thousand-dollar death benefit payable to the beneficiary or in statutory precedence order.

headings.title: Employment of pre-1999 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 1999, as special consultants with additional monthly compensation.

headings.title: Employment of pre-2000 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 2000, as special consultants with statutory compensation adjustments.

headings.title: Employment of pre-2001 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 2001, as special consultants entitled to enhanced monthly allowances.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 24 editorial headings for 169.070 governing PSRS retirement formulas, optional survivor plans, contribution refunds, disability, OASI adjustments, COLAs, IRC 415 limits, and special consultant compensation/minimums.

headings.title: Eligibility to elect partial lump sum distribution at retirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes eligible retiring members who have not received prior allowances to elect a partial lump sum distribution.

headings.title: Lump sum distribution options and monthly allowance reduction
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to elect a lump sum equal to twelve, twenty-four, or thirty-six times initial monthly allowance.

headings.title: Actuarial reduction of monthly retirement allowance following lump sum
headings.reviewNote: Directs actuarial reduction of member's ongoing monthly retirement allowance to reflect lump sum distribution.

headings.title: Payment of lump sum distribution upon member death before receipt
headings.reviewNote: Governs payment of lump sum distribution under board rules if member dies before payment is completed.

headings.title: Internal Revenue Code Section 415 limits on lump sum distributions
headings.reviewNote: Subordinates lump sum distributions and monthly allowances to benefit ceilings of Section 415 of Internal Revenue Code.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.073 governing PSRS partial lump sum option eligibility, 12/24/36-month options, actuarial reduction, pre-receipt death rules, and IRC Section 415 limits.

headings.title: Election of monthly survivor benefits in lieu of contribution refund
headings.reviewNote: Allows eligible surviving dependents to elect monthly survivor allowances in lieu of lump-sum contribution refunds.

headings.title: Monthly survivor allowance for surviving spouse at age sixty or disabled
headings.reviewNote: Provides monthly survivor allowance to surviving spouse upon reaching age sixty or if totally and permanently disabled.

headings.title: Monthly survivor allowance for surviving spouse with minor children
headings.reviewNote: Grants monthly survivor benefits to sole surviving spouse caring for deceased member's dependent unmarried children.

headings.title: Monthly survivor allowance for dependent unmarried children
headings.reviewNote: Provides equal shares of monthly survivor allowance directly to surviving dependent unmarried children under eighteen.

headings.title: Direct payment election for dependent children in lieu of lump sum
headings.reviewNote: Allows designated beneficiary to direct monthly payments to surviving dependent children in lieu of taking lump sum.

headings.title: Monthly survivor allowance for dependent parents age sixty-five
headings.reviewNote: Provides monthly survivor benefits to dependent surviving parents age sixty-five or older designated as beneficiaries.

headings.title: Single membership limit and board authority over dependency questions
headings.reviewNote: Bars a survivor from eligibility under this section from more than one terminated membership and vests the board of trustees with authority to decide all questions of doubt as to dependency.

headings.title: Retroactive application of 1991 clarifying amendments to survivor benefits
headings.reviewNote: Provides that 1991 clarifying statutory language applies retroactively to all pending and existing survivor cases.

headings.title: Application of enhanced survivor benefit schedules after July 1, 2000
headings.reviewNote: Makes enhanced survivor benefit schedules payable to eligible current and future beneficiaries effective July 1, 2000.

headings.title: Full monthly allowance payment for month in which recipient dies
headings.reviewNote: Directs system to pay full monthly retirement or survivor allowance for the calendar month in which recipient dies.

headings.title: Refund of unexhausted accumulated contributions to electing survivor
headings.reviewNote: Directs refund of any remaining member contributions to electing survivor if total benefits paid are less than contributions.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 11 editorial headings for 169.075 governing PSRS survivor benefit elections, spouse/child/parent allowances, single-membership bar and dependency decisions, retroactive/effective rules, final-month payments, and unexhausted contribution refunds.

headings.title: Order of precedence absent valid beneficiary designation before retirement
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a six-tier order of precedence (surviving spouse, section 169.075-eligible children, other children, dependent parents, other parents, estate) for electing and receiving benefits under section 169.070(3)(2)(a)-(b) or 169.075.

headings.title: Revocation of prior beneficiary designations by new filing or life events
headings.reviewNote: Revokes prior designations upon a newer filing or actual notice of marriage, divorce, contribution withdrawal, or birth/adoption of a child before payment, excluding monthly survivor designations under section 169.070(3)(1).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.076 governing statutory beneficiary order of precedence upon pre-retirement death without a valid designation and automatic revocation events.

headings.title: PSRS membership for teachers employed by division of youth services
headings.reviewNote: Extends PSRS membership and service credit to certified teachers employed by the division of youth services prior to 1986.

headings.title: PSRS membership for certified teachers in department of social services
headings.reviewNote: Allows certified teachers in department of social services divisions to participate in PSRS upon election.

headings.title: PSRS membership for teachers in department of corrections inmate education
headings.reviewNote: Extends system membership to certified teachers employed in inmate education programs of the department of corrections.

headings.title: Membership for certified teachers in statewide educational associations
headings.reviewNote: Permits full-time certificated employees of qualifying statewide nonprofit educational associations to be PSRS members (with employer contributions paid by the association), and bars additional nonprofit associations from joining PSRS or PEERS after June 30, 2010.

headings.title: Membership for certified teachers in department of mental health programs
headings.reviewNote: Extends PSRS membership options to certified teachers employed in educational programs of the department of mental health.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.130 governing PSRS membership for pre-August 13, 1986 certified teachers in DYS, DSS, DOC inmate education, DMH, and statewide nonprofit educational associations.

headings.title: Nomination of successor beneficiary upon divorce or spouse death
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes retirants who elected spousal survivor options to nominate successor spouse beneficiary upon divorce or death.

headings.title: Procedures, filing deadlines, and actuarial adjustment for successor nomination
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 1 successor nominations to follow board procedures, be filed within ninety days of May 6, 1993, or one year of remarriage (whichever is later), and triggers actuarial allowance adjustment.

headings.title: Cancellation of survivor option and benefit restoration upon divorce
headings.reviewNote: Permits retirant to cancel spousal survivor option and pop up to full single-life allowance following divorce.

headings.title: Option 1 pop-up for pre-September 2015 same-sex domestic partner elections
headings.reviewNote: Permits retirants who on or before September 1, 2015, nominated a same-sex domestic partner under section 169.070(3) to increase to Option 1 upon affidavit of ended partnership, written beneficiary consent or post-September 1, 2023 court order, and dissolution decree if legally married.

headings.title: Successor spouse nomination after death or end of same-sex domestic partner
headings.reviewNote: Permits retirants who on or before September 1, 2015, nominated a same-sex domestic partner to nominate a spouse upon later marriage following the partner's death or ended partnership/removal (plus dissolution if married); source footnote notes original rolls say 'subsection (2) of this section'.

headings.title: Filing deadlines and actuarial adjustment for subsection 5 nominations
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 5 successor nominations to follow board procedures, be filed within one year of September 1, 2023, or one year of marriage (whichever is later), and triggers actuarial allowance adjustment.

headings.title: Statutory definition of same-sex domestic partners
headings.reviewNote: Defines same-sex domestic partners as unrelated adults of the same sex sharing a mutual residence and domestic life.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.141 governing PSRS successor beneficiary nominations, filing deadlines and actuarial adjustments, post-divorce Option 1 pop-up, and same-sex domestic partner pop-up/successor provisions.

headings.title: Establishment of retirement system in Kansas City urban school district
headings.reviewNote: Creates a retirement system for teachers and employees in Kansas City urban school district as a body corporate.

headings.title: Continuation of statutory governance after population shift or district lapse
headings.reviewNote: Provides that sections 169.270 to 169.400 continue governing the retirement system even if district or city population thresholds change or the school district's corporate organization lapses under section 162.081(1) and (4).

headings.title: Federal tax qualification and exclusive benefit of members
headings.reviewNote: Requires system to operate as a qualified governmental pension plan under Section 401(a) for exclusive benefit of members.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.280 establishing the Kansas City school district retirement system, continuing governance after population shifts or district lapse, and declaring federal qualified-plan exclusive-benefit intent.

headings.title: Composition and selection of Kansas City board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Vests administration in a twelve-member board of resident taxpayers: four appointed by the board of education, four elected by members, the superintendent, two elected by retirants, and one appointed by the section 182.701(3) board.

headings.title: Filling of trustee vacancies and continuity of board powers
headings.reviewNote: Directs filling vacancies for unexpired terms in the original manner (allowing temporary board appointment for elected vacancies until the next regular election) and preserves remaining trustees' authority.

headings.title: Board governance and vacancy appointments after school district lapse
headings.reviewNote: Continues governance by a twelve-member board of city resident taxpayers if the school district lapses under section 162.081(1) and (4), and authorizes the board to appoint qualified replacements for up to four-year terms.

headings.title: Trustee oath of office before circuit court and clerk filing
headings.reviewNote: Requires each trustee before assuming duties to take an oath of honest, diligent administration before a circuit court of the district's judicial circuit, subscribed and filed with the circuit clerk.

headings.title: Trustee voting, seven-member quorum, and post-lapse majority rule
headings.reviewNote: Grants each trustee one vote and requires seven trustees for a quorum and board decision, or a majority of trustees then in office following a section 162.081(1) and (4) corporate lapse.

headings.title: Exclusive original board jurisdiction, judicial review, and rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Vests exclusive original jurisdiction in the board over all fund matters and benefit/refund claims (reviewable under chapter 536 or 621) and requires establishing rules for fund administration, business, and claim deadlines.

headings.title: Uncompensated trustees, officers, executive director, and investment counsel
headings.reviewNote: Provides trustees serve without compensation, requires electing a chairman and vice chairman, appointing an executive director/secretary, employing investment counsel, and paying approved expenses from investment income.

headings.title: Maintenance of data for actuarial valuations and experience checks
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board of trustees to keep data in convenient form necessary for actuarial valuations of system funds and checking system experience.

headings.title: Public record of proceedings and annual fiscal and actuarial report
headings.reviewNote: Requires keeping a public record of proceedings and furnishing an annual fiscal, asset, and actuarial balance-sheet report to the board of education and requesting members.

headings.title: Corporate powers of board and immunity from personal liability

headings.title: Board duty to arrange necessary legal advice for system operations
headings.reviewNote: Requires the board of trustees to arrange for necessary legal advice for the operation of the retirement system.

headings.title: Designation and duties of three-physician medical board
headings.reviewNote: Requires designating a medical board of three or more non-member physicians to pass on required medical exams, investigate disability application statements, and report written recommendations to the board.

headings.title: Designation and qualifications of consulting actuary
headings.reviewNote: Requires designating an actuary qualified as a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries or by similar objective standards to serve as technical advisor to the board.

headings.title: Five-year actuarial experience investigation and assumption adoption
headings.reviewNote: Requires the actuary at least once every five years to investigate actuarial experience and directs the board to adopt necessary actuarial assumptions for financial soundness.

headings.title: Annual actuarial valuation of retirement system funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires the actuary to make annual valuations of the assets and liabilities of system funds based on board-adopted actuarial assumptions.

headings.title: Employer contribution rate schedule and post-2014 certification
headings.reviewNote: Sets historical employer rates from 1993 through 2013 (1.99% to 7.5%), and for 2014 onward directs determination under section 169.350(4) and (6) with board certification at least six months before effectiveness.

headings.title: Asset protections upon school district corporate organization lapse
headings.reviewNote: Bars transferring or merging a retirement system or its assets upon a section 162.081(1) and (4) corporate lapse without prior approval of the system's board of trustees.

headings.title: Annual interest crediting to individual member accounts

headings.title: Election of treasurer and custodian bond requirements

headings.title: Cash operating reserves limit for benefit disbursements

headings.title: Conflict of interest and personal gain prohibitions for trustees

headings.title: Board agreements for early retirement and group exit incentives

headings.title: Indemnification of trustees and employees by retirement system

headings.title: Procurement of fiduciary liability insurance policies

headings.title: Fifteen-day written notice requirement for indemnification claims
headings.reviewNote: Conditions indemnification rights upon trustee or employee serving written notice within fifteen days of process.

headings.title: Vesting of retirement benefits after five years of creditable service
headings.reviewNote: Vests member retirement benefits upon completion of five years of actual Missouri creditable service.

headings.title: Continuation of membership under 1961 statutory election

headings.title: Suspension and recalculation of benefits upon member reemployment
headings.reviewNote: Suspends retirement allowance upon reemployment as active member and recalculates pension upon subsequent retirement.

headings.title: Nonforfeitability of accrued benefits upon complete system termination
headings.reviewNote: Vests all accrued member benefits nonforfeitably in the event of complete plan termination or contribution discontinuance.

headings.title: Death benefits during qualified military service under USERRA
headings.reviewNote: Provides survivor benefits to beneficiaries of members dying during qualified military service under Section 414(u).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.301 governing five-year vesting, 1961 plan continuation/transfer, reemployment suspension/recalculation, nonforfeitability on termination, and qualified military service death benefits.

headings.title: Board rulemaking authority for purchasing creditable service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to adopt rules permitting active members to purchase creditable service under statutory conditions.

headings.title: Repurchase of previously refunded service credit upon reemployment
headings.reviewNote: Allows reemployed members to purchase and restore previously refunded service credit by repaying contributions with interest.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for in-state public school or library work
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to purchase credit for prior public school or library service rendered elsewhere in Missouri.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for out-of-state public education service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes purchasing service credit for public school, college, or university employment performed in other states.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for certified private school teaching
headings.reviewNote: Allows members to purchase retirement service credit for prior certified full-time private school or university teaching.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for active military or defense service
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing retirement service credit for periods of active duty service in the United States Armed Forces.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for approved unpaid leaves of absence
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing creditable service for employer-approved unpaid leaves for academic study, illness, or other board-authorized circumstances under board rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.315 governing Kansas City creditable service purchase rules for refunded, in-state/out-of-state public, certified private, military, and approved unpaid leave service.

headings.title: Application and medical certification for disability retirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes disability retirement for active members with five years' service upon medical board certification of permanent incapacity.

headings.title: Calculation of annual disability retirement allowance
headings.reviewNote: Computes disability allowance as a section 169.324 service allowance, subject to a minimum equal to the lesser of 25 percent of average final compensation or the allowance projected to age sixty.

headings.title: Periodic medical re-examinations of disability retirants
headings.reviewNote: Permits annual re-examinations during the first five years and triennial re-examinations thereafter before normal retirement age; refusal may discontinue allowance and one-year refusal revokes rights.

headings.title: Reduction of disability allowance upon engaging in gainful occupation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to reduce disability pension if retirant earns income exceeding difference between allowance and prior salary.

headings.title: Cessation of disability pension and membership restoration upon recovery
headings.reviewNote: Terminates disability allowance and restores member to active service and membership upon medical recovery.

headings.reviewNote: Calculates annual service retirement allowance by multiplying years of service by average final compensation and plan percentage.

headings.title: Suspension of retirement allowance during employer reemployment

headings.title: Annual determination of cost-of-living increase by board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual board determination of whether investment returns can fund a benefit increase for eligible retirants and survivors, subject to actuary recommendation and four safeguards (100% funded ratio, ARC within contribution rate, actuarial soundness certification, and non-reduction).

headings.title: No statutory guarantee of annual cost-of-living increases

headings.title: Compliance of retirement allowances with IRC Section 415 limitations
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual service retirement allowances under sections 169.270 to 169.400, including subsection 3 adjustments, to comply at all times with Internal Revenue Code Section 415 and regulations.

headings.reviewNote: Requires retirement system to implement an affirmative procurement plan utilizing minority and women investment managers.

headings.title: Election of optional retirement payment plans prior to first payment

headings.title: Lump-sum refund of unexhausted contributions upon retirant death
headings.reviewNote: Directs refund of excess accumulated contributions to estate if retirant dies before receiving benefits equal to contributions.

headings.title: Survivor benefits upon death of active or eligible inactive member
headings.reviewNote: Provides survivor annuity options to eligible dependent spouses, children, or parents upon member death before retirement.

headings.reviewNote: Requires all retirement benefit distributions to satisfy federal required minimum distribution rules of Section 401(a)(9).

headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies any person from receiving retirement benefits who intentionally causes the death of the member or retirant.

headings.reviewNote: Requires the board of trustees to pay a former unvested member's unwithdrawn accumulated contributions within a reasonable time after four years from cessation of membership (other than by death or retirement).

headings.title: Transfer of undeliverable funds to general reserve and later reclamation

headings.reviewNote: Permits the board in its discretion to extend any time periods in this section for a former member's military or naval service, academic study, or illness.

headings.reviewNote: Permits distributees to elect direct trustee-to-trustee rollovers of eligible retirement distributions to eligible retirement plans.

headings.title: Full-time employment of retired teachers without suspension of benefits
headings.reviewNote: Permits retired certificated teachers to teach full time up to four years in a shortage district without losing benefits, capping the total number at any one time at thirty certificated teachers.

headings.title: Payment of employer and employee contribution rates during employment
headings.reviewNote: Requires the hiring school district to pay the employer's contribution rate and the employee to pay the employee's contribution rate.

headings.title: Hiring school district liability for additional actuarial costs
headings.reviewNote: Requires the hiring school district to pay any additional actuarial costs resulting from hiring a retired certificated teacher under this section.

headings.title: School district obligations to demonstrate good faith recruiting efforts
headings.reviewNote: Directs school districts to document good faith recruiting efforts to hire non-retired teachers prior to hiring retirees.

headings.title: Reporting of hired retired teachers to State Directory of New Hires
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting any person hired under this section to the State Directory of New Hires (printed as 'State Director of New Hires' in archived text) under 42 U.S.C. Section 1320b-7.

headings.reviewNote: Credits system assets to the employees' contribution fund or general reserve fund, mandates member payroll deductions and deemed consent, governs withdrawals/retirement transfers, and permits employer board pickup elections.

headings.title: General reserve fund credits and active-service restoration transfers
headings.reviewNote: Accumulates benefit reserves and employer contributions (except employer-paid member pickups) in the general reserve fund, and transfers excess accumulated contributions back to the employees' contribution fund upon restoration to active service.

headings.title: Acceptance and deposit of gifts, devises, bequests, and legacies
headings.reviewNote: Permits the board of trustees to accept gifts, devises, bequests, and legacies for deposit in the general reserve fund, subject to any donor-specified direction.

headings.title: Service credit for honorable military service during active employment

headings.title: Full contribution deductions during approved leaves of absence with pay

headings.title: Vesting of St. Louis retirement system administration in board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Vests administration of the St. Louis retirement system in a thirteen-member board of trustees: four appointed by the board of education, four elected by active members, two elected by retirees, one elected school administrator, and two appointed by the Missouri Charter Public School Association.

headings.title: Filling of trustee vacancies for unexpired terms
headings.reviewNote: Provides that trustee vacancies shall be filled for unexpired terms in the same manner as original appointments or elections.

headings.title: Preservation of board authority during lapse of school district organization
headings.reviewNote: Protects board governance and system asset administration during any lapse or dissolution of school district organization.

headings.title: Trustee service without compensation and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Provides that trustees serve without compensation but receive reimbursement from expense fund for necessary expenses.

headings.title: Trustee constitutional oath of office taken before circuit clerk
headings.reviewNote: Requires each trustee to take and subscribe to a constitutional oath of office before the circuit clerk within ten days.

headings.title: Circuit court equity jurisdiction over official conduct of trustees

headings.title: Voting rights of trustees and seven-member quorum requirement
headings.reviewNote: Grants each trustee one vote and designates seven trustees as a quorum necessary to transact official board business.

headings.title: Board authority to establish administrative rules and regulations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to adopt rules and regulations for administration of funds, eligibility, and application procedures.

headings.reviewNote: Requires board to employ an actuary as technical advisor on system finances, mortality tables, and plan valuations.

headings.title: Annual actuarial valuation of system assets and liabilities
headings.reviewNote: Directs actuary to conduct annual actuarial valuations of retirement system fund assets, liabilities, and required reserves.

headings.title: Minimum total benefit guarantee equal to accumulated contributions

headings.title: Optional reduced survivor and Social Security leveling plans (options 1 to 5)
headings.reviewNote: Permits electing actuarial equivalent options 1 through 5 (including pop-up options 3–4, age-62 Social Security leveling option 5, and combinations 1+5 or 2+5), capping non-spouse survivor benefits at fifty percent.

headings.title: Minimum pension guarantee for members retiring at age sixty-five
