headings.title: Maintenance of expense and contingency reserve within system fund
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes maintaining an expense and contingency reserve to cover administrative costs and investment contingencies.

headings.title: Acceptance of gifts, devises, and bequests by board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Empowers board to accept gifts, devises, and bequests to be invested and held as general assets of the retirement system.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 editorial headings for 169.490 governing holding St. Louis assets as one fund, tiered member deductions and pickup, active-service restoration credits, statutory employer rate schedules (2018–2026+), expense reserve, and gifts.

headings.title: Legal obligations of system funds for benefit payments and expenses
headings.reviewNote: Designates pension benefits, refunds, and operating administrative expenses as legal obligations payable from system assets.

headings.title: Protection of deposited member contributions against statutory changes
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees that alteration or repeal of statutes shall not impair member rights regarding accumulated deposits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.510 governing St. Louis system asset obligations (not employer obligations) and protection of member deposits and accrued benefits against statutory changes.

headings.title: Part-time or temporary substitute employment of retired educators
headings.reviewNote: Allows retired teachers to work up to 550 hours per year without reduction or suspension of retirement allowances.

headings.title: Employment of PSRS retirees in noncertificated positions and earnings caps
headings.reviewNote: Permits PSRS retirees to work in noncertificated positions earning up to 133% of the 20 CFR 404.430 Social Security exemption (Aug. 28, 2023–June 30, 2028) and 100% thereafter with employer PEERS contributions, excluding public community colleges and section 169.130(4) employers.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.560 governing PSRS retiree part-time/substitute work (550 hours / 50% salary) and noncertificated employment subject to Social Security earnings limits.

headings.title: Joint comprehensive study of teacher mobility between retirement systems
headings.reviewNote: Requires PSRS, Kansas City, and St. Louis retirement systems to conduct a joint study on teacher service portability.

headings.title: Coordination of portability study by joint committee on retirement
headings.reviewNote: Directs legislative joint committee on public employee retirement to coordinate and assist with mobility study.

headings.title: Submission of final portability study to legislative leadership
headings.reviewNote: Requires the joint committee on public employee retirement to present the study to the senate president pro tem and house speaker no later than November 1, 1999.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.566 governing the joint portability feasibility study by PSRS, Kansas City, and St. Louis systems, legislative committee coordination, and November 1, 1999 submission.

headings.title: Joint rules for service recognition without transfer of credit or assets
headings.reviewNote: Requires PSRS, Kansas City, St. Louis, and PEERS to promulgate joint rules recognizing service toward retirement eligibility across the four systems, expressly prohibiting any transfer of creditable service or system assets.

headings.title: Approval and amendment of joint portability rules by system boards
headings.reviewNote: Requires joint rules to be approved by majority vote of trustees of each retirement board with thirty days' notice.

headings.title: Compliance with chapter 536 administrative rulemaking requirements
headings.reviewNote: Subordinates joint administrative portability rules to state rulemaking procedures and legislative review under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.569 governing joint rules for inter-system service recognition (without asset or credit transfer), trustee approval/JCPER filing, and chapter 536 nonseverability.

headings.title: Transfer of service credit for nonvested members changing systems
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes nonvested employees with less than five years' service to transfer service credit upon moving to another system.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for prior service in other Missouri teacher systems
headings.reviewNote: Allows members with previous service in another Missouri school retirement system to purchase equivalent service credit.

headings.title: Non-diminution of statutory benefits under other retirement systems
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that transfer provisions shall not decrease or discontinue existing statutory retirement benefits.

headings.title: Completion of transfer payments prior to termination of membership
headings.reviewNote: Requires all transfer and purchase payments to be completed with interest prior to terminating membership in system.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 editorial headings for 169.570 governing purchasing membership credit across Missouri public school retirement systems, non-diminution of benefits, and payment/service completion requirements.

headings.title: Prohibition on dividing federal Social Security benefits in divorce
headings.reviewNote: Bars state courts from dividing or setting aside federal Social Security insurance benefits in marriage dissolution actions.

headings.title: Division of chapter 169 benefits limited to same extent as Social Security
headings.reviewNote: Provides that after August 28, 1991, a court may divide chapter 169 benefits in marriage dissolution to the same extent and manner as federal Social Security benefits (which subsection 1 bars dividing); archived 1993 and 2003 case annotations note benefits are non-divisible, nonmarital property.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.572 barring division of Social Security benefits in dissolution of marriage and limiting division of chapter 169 benefits to the same extent as Social Security.

headings.title: Employment of early retired teachers as special advisors
headings.reviewNote: Employs retired public school teachers with five or more years who retired after June 30, 1957, and prior to January 1, 1971, as special school advisors at $5/month per year (max $75/month, $150/month combined cap).

headings.title: Annual actuarial review of financial effect of advisor payments
headings.reviewNote: Requires system actuary to determine annually whether advisor compensation payments impair financial stability of funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.585 governing special school advisor employment for 1957–1970 retired teachers and annual actuarial impairment billing to last employing districts.

headings.title: Service credit for uniformed military service under USERRA
headings.reviewNote: Permits members reemployed following uniformed military service to receive service credit by paying contributions.

headings.title: Statutory definition of discharge from the Armed Forces
headings.reviewNote: Defines discharge from the Armed Forces as final discharge date rather than the last day of active duty service.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.589 governing USERRA uniformed service vesting and contribution elections in PSRS/PEERS and defining discharge from the Armed Forces.

headings.title: Inclusion of retired employees and survivors in district health plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires school district group health insurance plans to cover retired employees and surviving spouses on same basis.

headings.title: Different coverage levels permitted for Medicare-eligible retirees
headings.reviewNote: Permits a group health plan or noninsurance health benefit program to provide a different level of coverage for electing persons eligible for Medicare under 42 U.S.C. 1395.

headings.title: Payment of group health insurance premiums by retired employees
headings.reviewNote: Requires a person electing to become or remain a member of a group health plan or noninsurance program under subsection 1 to pay the premium for such coverage, including covered dependents.

headings.title: District contract requirements for insurance coverage of retirees
headings.reviewNote: Requires district insurance contracts to specify coverage for retirees, spouses, and unmarried dependent children with at least a thirty-day enrollment period, and gives employees one year from last employment to qualify.

headings.title: State aid deduction penalty for district noncompliance with health rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires deduction from school district state aid equal to health insurance premiums if district fails to cover retirees.

headings.title: Statutory definition of noninsurance health benefit programs
headings.reviewNote: Defines noninsurance health benefit programs to include expense-incurred plans, HMOs, and self-funded district arrangements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 editorial headings for 169.590 governing retiree and survivor inclusion in school district group health plans, Medicare coverage adjustments, retiree premiums, contract notice, state aid penalties, and definitions.

headings.title: Full-time employment of retired PSRS teachers without loss of benefits
headings.reviewNote: Permits retired PSRS certificated teachers to teach full time up to four years in a shortage district (excluding superintendent positions) without losing benefits, capped at the greater of 1% of total staff or five teachers.

headings.title: Full-time employment of retired PEERS personnel without loss of benefits
headings.reviewNote: Permits retired PEERS noncertificated employees to work full time up to four years in a shortage district without losing benefits, capped at the lesser of 10% of noncertificated staff or five employees.

headings.title: Hiring district obligation to pay employer retirement contributions
headings.reviewNote: Requires hiring school district to contribute standard employer retirement percentages on compensation paid to retirees.

headings.title: District requirements to demonstrate good faith recruiting efforts
headings.reviewNote: Directs school districts to document advertising and recruiting efforts to hire non-retired applicants before hiring retirees.

headings.title: Reporting of employed retirees to State Directory of New Hires
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reporting all retirees hired under shortage provisions to the State Directory of New Hires for eligibility tracking.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.596 governing full-time PSRS and PEERS shortage-area retiree employment without benefit loss, employer contributions, recruiting criteria, and New Hires reporting.

headings.title: Establishment of retirement system for nonteacher school employees
headings.reviewNote: Creates the public education employee retirement system (PEERS) as a body corporate for noncertificated school personnel.

headings.title: Administration of nonteacher retirement system by PSRS board
headings.reviewNote: Vests general administration and operational responsibility of PEERS in the board of trustees of PSRS.

headings.title: Segregation of PEERS funds and governance under general statutes
headings.reviewNote: Requires PEERS funds to be kept strictly separate from other funds while administered pursuant to section 169.020.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.610 establishing PEERS as a body corporate, vesting administration in the PSRS board of trustees, and requiring fund segregation.

headings.title: Agreement for merger of community college local system into PEERS
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board of trustees to execute merger agreement absorbing community college nonteacher retirement system into PEERS.

headings.title: Mandatory PEERS membership for community college employees upon merger
headings.reviewNote: Requires all qualifying community college nonteacher employees to become active members of PEERS upon merger effective date.

headings.title: Transfer of member accounts, reserves, and assets to PEERS
headings.reviewNote: Directs transfer of all local community college retirement funds, member contributions, and employer reserves to PEERS.

headings.title: Recognition of service credit established under merged college system
headings.reviewNote: Grants members full creditable service in PEERS for all service accrued under former community college retirement system.

headings.title: Actuarial certification required prior to executing merger agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires consulting actuary to certify that merger will not impair actuarial soundness or solvency of PEERS.

headings.title: Equal benefit guarantees for merged community college members
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees that merged community college employees receive benefits equal to those provided to other PEERS members.

headings.title: Continuation of benefits to existing community college retirees
headings.reviewNote: Directs PEERS to continue paying retirement, disability, and survivor benefits to former members retired before merger.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.611 governing agreements to merge community college local nonteacher retirement systems into PEERS, membership, asset transfer, service credit, actuarial certification, equal benefits, and retiree continuation.

headings.title: Equal contribution obligations for PEERS members and employers
headings.reviewNote: Requires PEERS retirement funding through equal matching contributions paid by covered employees and school employers.

headings.title: Annual transmission of contributions and civil and misdemeanor penalties
headings.reviewNote: Requires employers each school year to transmit twice the deductible amount, imposes individual civil liability for twice the withheld amount, makes willful refusal a misdemeanor ($25–$200/day), and allows board information requests.

headings.title: Payroll deductions, salary floor, pre-1996 medical benefits, and IRC cap
headings.reviewNote: Requires paycheck deductions with a $1,200 minimum annual salary floor, deems pre-February 20, 1996 medical-benefit salary treatments compliant without refund/adjustment, and applies IRC Section 401(a)(17) compensation limits.

headings.title: Annual actuarial certification and limits on PEERS contribution rate
headings.reviewNote: Directs board to fix and certify annual level contribution rates based on actuarial recommendations within statutory caps.

headings.title: Deemed employee consent to payroll deductions and salary discharge
headings.reviewNote: Deems every employee to consent to statutory payroll deductions and makes payment of salary less deductions a full discharge of salary claims except as to sections 169.600 to 169.715 benefits.

headings.title: Election of service credit for pre-1974 part-time school employment
headings.reviewNote: Permits members employed twenty or more hours per week between 1965 and 1974 to purchase prior service credit.

headings.title: Restriction on legislative benefit increases after July 1, 2003
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits enacting legislation after July 1, 2003, increasing PEERS benefits above what a 5 percent contribution rate can fund, except legislation extending election deadlines under section 169.670(1)(4).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.620 governing equal PEERS contributions, annual transmission and penalties, payroll deductions and IRC 401(a)(17) caps, actuarial rate setting, deemed consent, 1965–1974 part-time credit, and post-July 1, 2003 benefit caps.

headings.title: Ownership and fiduciary control of PEERS funds by board of trustees
headings.reviewNote: Provides that all funds belong to PEERS and are under exclusive investment and fiduciary control of the board of trustees.

headings.title: Prudent person investment standard and authorized PEERS securities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes investment of funds exceeding safe operating balances under prudent person rule in authorized securities.

headings.title: Creation of combined PSRS and PEERS investment fund account
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes maintaining a joint investment fund account for PEERS and PSRS to invest and commingle assets.

headings.title: Board member conflict bans and nominee, bearer, or book-entry holding
headings.reviewNote: Bars board members from having interests in or profiting from investment transactions, and authorizes holding securities via custodians, nominees, bearer/book-entry form, central depositories, or Federal Reserve book-entry systems.

headings.title: Designation of bank or trust company as investment custodian
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board to designate a qualified bank or trust company as depository, custodian, and investment intermediary.

headings.title: Mandatory payment of allowances by electronic funds transfer
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of retirement allowances and periodic benefits by electronic funds transfer unless board waives.

headings.title: Closed board meetings for deliberations on investment transactions
headings.reviewNote: Permits closed meetings under Sunshine Law to deliberate on investment purchases or sales where disclosure damages value.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.630 governing PEERS fund ownership, section 169.040 investment standards, combined PSRS/PEERS investment account, trustee conflicts and nominee holding, bank depository, EFT payments, and closed investment meetings.

headings.title: Mandatory PEERS membership for nonteacher school employees
headings.reviewNote: Makes all section 169.600 employees (plus qualifying five-year disabled employees preceding October 13, 1965) members by virtue of employment and excludes common-law independent contractors.

headings.title: Prior service credit for employment rendered before November 1965
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes claiming prior service credit for noncertificated services rendered in Missouri public schools prior to 1965.

headings.title: Events terminating membership in nonteacher retirement system
headings.reviewNote: Specifies events terminating membership including five consecutive years without service, death, retirement, or refund.

headings.title: Forfeiture and reinstatement of creditable service upon contribution refund
headings.reviewNote: Provides that refund forfeits service, but permits reinstatement upon subsequent reemployment and contribution repayment.

headings.title: Membership eligibility for employees of educational associations
headings.reviewNote: Permits non-PSRS employees working at least twenty hours per week for statewide nonprofit PEERS educational associations to join PEERS, requires separate section 169.130(4) application for certificated staff, and bars additional associations after June 30, 2010; source footnote notes 'employee' appears in original rolls.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.650 governing PEERS mandatory membership and independent contractor exclusion, pre-1965 prior service, membership termination, forfeiture/reinstatement, and educational association membership.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria for purchasing PEERS creditable service
headings.reviewNote: Sets conditions for purchasing service credit, requiring one year of accrued PEERS service and covered employment.

headings.title: Maximum limitation on purchased service credit
headings.reviewNote: Limits total service credit purchased under section to member's actual accrued Missouri PEERS membership service.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for prior in-state or out-of-state public education service
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing equivalent membership service credit for regular employment of at least twenty hours per week by a public school district, public community college, public college, or public university inside or outside Missouri.

headings.title: Purchase of membership credit for honorable military service
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to purchase retirement service credit for periods of active duty service in the United States Armed Forces.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for unpaid maternity or paternity leave
headings.reviewNote: Allows members to purchase retirement credit for periods of approved unpaid maternity or paternity leave.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit by certified vocational-technical personnel
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified vocational personnel to purchase credit for required trade, technical, or occupational experience.

headings.title: Purchase of forfeited service credit from PSRS system
headings.reviewNote: Permits members to purchase and transfer previously forfeited teacher service credit from PSRS into PEERS.

headings.title: Purchase of credit for leave with nonprofit education support entities
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing credit for regular employment of twenty or more hours per week while on leave from a section 169.600 employer for a nonprofit corporation or agency whose primary purpose is education support or research.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for private school or university employment
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes members to purchase service credit for qualifying regular employment performed in private schools or colleges.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for nonfederal public employment
headings.reviewNote: Permits purchasing equivalent creditable service for regular nonfederal public employment of at least twenty hours per week, subject to this section.

headings.title: Purchase of service credit for employment covered by Social Security
headings.reviewNote: Allows members age eighteen or older to purchase service credit for prior regular employment covered by Social Security.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 11 editorial headings for 169.655 governing PEERS service purchase terms/recalculation, purchase caps, and eligible prior public education, military, parental leave, vo-tech, PSRS, nonprofit leave, private education, nonfederal public, and Social Security employment.

headings.title: Age and service eligibility criteria for PEERS service retirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes full PEERS retirement at age sixty with five years, age fifty-five with twenty-five years, or thirty years regardless of age, and refunds contributions to members retiring with fewer than five years.

headings.title: Part-time or temporary substitute employment of retired PEERS members
headings.reviewNote: Allows retired nonteachers to work up to 550 hours per school year for covered employers without loss of retirement benefits.

headings.title: Full monthly allowance payment for month in which recipient dies
headings.reviewNote: Directs system to pay full monthly retirement allowance for the calendar month in which retired member or beneficiary dies.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.660 governing PEERS service retirement eligibility, 550-hour part-time/substitute reemployment, and full monthly payment for month of death.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria and medical certification for disability retirement
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes disability retirement for active nonteachers with five years' service upon medical certification of incapacity.

headings.title: Total and permanent disability standard for retirement benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires disability to render member permanently incapable of earning a livelihood in any gainful occupation.

headings.title: Coordination and adjustments for federal Social Security disability benefits
headings.reviewNote: Coordinates PEERS disability allowances with federal Social Security disability benefit offsets pursuant to federal regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.663 governing PEERS disability retirement eligibility and recovery, permanent disability adjudication, and Social Security offset treatment for age-55/25-year recipients.

headings.title: Normal retirement allowance calculation formula for nonteachers
headings.reviewNote: Computes PEERS normal retirement allowance (1.61% per membership year, prior service, pre-1973 excess formula, reduced age-under-55 25–29 year options, and temporary 0.8% allowance until minimum Social Security retirement age for 30-year or rule-of-80 post-July 1, 2001 retirees).

headings.title: Annual cost-of-living increases and eighty percent cumulative cap
headings.reviewNote: Requires a 5% annual COLA if cost of living rises 5% or more (or board-determined increase up to 5% if less, none on decline), starting the fourth January 1 after retirement or January 1, 1982, with an 80% cumulative cap after December 31, 1981.

headings.title: Discretionary COLA reduction when cost of living falls below initial level
headings.reviewNote: Permits the board to reduce subsection 2 COLA increases if the cost of living falls below its level at the time of the member's first increase, not exceeding total post-December 31, 1981 increases.

headings.title: Optional survivor plans (options 2 to 7) and pre-retirement death elections
headings.reviewNote: Permits electing reduced actuarial equivalent benefits under options 2 through 7 (including pop-up options 2–4, 120/60-month guarantees 5–6, and variable Social Security leveling option 7), and governs pre-retirement death option 2 elections.

headings.title: Refund of excess accumulated contributions upon death after retirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying any excess of accumulated contributions over total retirement or disability allowances paid before death (including after option 2, 3, or 4 beneficiary death) in statutory precedence order.

headings.title: Payment of final benefit when financial institution cannot accept payment
headings.reviewNote: Directs payment of final benefit(s) to the beneficiary or in statutory precedence order when a deceased member's or beneficiary's financial institution is unable to accept the final payment.

headings.title: Payment of accumulated contributions upon death before retirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying accumulated contributions to the beneficiary or in statutory precedence order upon death before receiving a retirement allowance, unless the beneficiary elects option 2 (with excess refund if beneficiary dies early).

headings.title: Refund of accumulated contributions upon permanent separation
headings.reviewNote: Requires paying accumulated contributions with interest if a member ceases to be an employee under section 169.600 and certifies permanence, or if membership is otherwise terminated.

headings.title: Deferred retirement allowance for vested members with five years' service
headings.reviewNote: Permits a member ceasing covered employment after five or more years of creditable service to leave contributions with PEERS and claim a retirement allowance upon reaching minimum voluntary retirement age.

headings.title: Disability retirement allowance formula at nine-tenths of age-60 benefit
headings.reviewNote: Sets the disability retirement allowance at nine-tenths of the allowance to which the member's creditable service would entitle the member at age sixty.

headings.title: Election of pre-October 13, 1969 allowance computation by earlier members
headings.reviewNote: Permits any member who was a member prior to October 13, 1969, to elect retirement allowance computation under sections 169.600 to 169.715 as they existed before October 13, 1969.

headings.title: Sworn spousal awareness statement on retirement application
headings.reviewNote: Requires any retirement application to include a sworn member statement certifying that the member's spouse at completion was aware of the application and elected retirement plan.

headings.title: Option pop-up adjustment for pre-August 14, 1984 retirees upon beneficiary death
headings.reviewNote: Entitles pre-August 14, 1984 retirees under option 1 or 2 whose nominated beneficiary dies to an actuarially adjusted increase upon application to the non-option retirement allowance.

headings.title: IRC Section 415 benefit limits and Section 415(m) excess benefit plan
headings.reviewNote: Limits PEERS benefits to Internal Revenue Code Section 415 ceilings and permits the board to establish and administer a Section 415(m) excess benefit plan.

headings.title: Employment of pre-1999 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 1999, as special consultants entitled to supplemental monthly compensation.

headings.title: Employment of pre-2000 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 2000, as special consultants with statutory compensation adjustments.

headings.title: Employment of pre-2001 retired members and beneficiaries as consultants
headings.reviewNote: Appoints members retired prior to July 1, 2001, as special consultants entitled to enhanced monthly allowances.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 17 editorial headings for 169.670 governing PEERS benefit formulas and temporary allowances, COLA increases/reductions, options 2–7, contribution refunds, deferred and disability allowances, pre-1969 election, spousal notice, pre-1984 pop-up, IRC 415 limits, and special consultant increases.

headings.title: Eligibility to elect partial lump sum distribution at retirement
headings.reviewNote: Permits eligible retiring PEERS members without prior allowances (rule of 86, 33 years, or age 63 with 8 years) to elect a partial lump sum on their application, unless electing option 7 under section 169.670(4)(1).

headings.title: Lump sum distribution options and monthly allowance reduction
headings.reviewNote: Permits electing a lump sum of 12, 24, or 36 times the option 1 monthly allowance (less any temporary allowance under section 169.670(1)(5)) in addition to the reduced monthly allowance.

headings.title: Actuarial reduction of monthly retirement allowance following lump sum
headings.reviewNote: Directs actuarial reduction of member's ongoing monthly retirement allowance to reflect lump sum distribution.

headings.title: Payment of lump sum distribution upon member death before receipt
headings.reviewNote: Governs payment of lump sum distribution under board rules if member dies before payment is completed.

headings.title: Internal Revenue Code Section 415 limits on lump sum distributions
headings.reviewNote: Subordinates PEERS partial lump sum and other benefits to Internal Revenue Code Section 415 limitations except as provided in 'subsection 13 of section 169.670' (as printed in archived source text; note Section 415(m) appears in subsection 14 of section 169.670).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 5 editorial headings for 169.673 governing PEERS partial lump sum eligibility (excluding option 7), 12/24/36-month options, actuarial reduction, pre-receipt death rules, and IRC Section 415 limits.

headings.title: Order of precedence absent valid beneficiary designation before retirement
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a four-tier order of precedence (surviving spouse, surviving children, surviving parents, estate) for electing and receiving benefits under section 169.670(4)(2)(a)-(b) upon pre-retirement death without a valid designation.

headings.title: Revocation of prior beneficiary designations by new filing or life events
headings.reviewNote: Revokes prior designations upon a newer filing or actual notice of marriage, divorce, contribution withdrawal, or birth/adoption of a child before payment, excluding monthly survivor designations under section 169.670(4)(1).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 editorial headings for 169.676 governing statutory beneficiary order of precedence upon pre-retirement death without a valid designation and automatic revocation events in PEERS.

headings.title: PSRS membership and PEERS option for certificated teachers in PEERS roles
headings.reviewNote: Places certificated teachers first employed after August 28, 1997, in PEERS-qualifying positions into PSRS with pro rata credit, while granting a ninety-day option to elect PEERS membership instead.

headings.title: PSRS membership and PEERS option for 17-to-20-hour certificated staff
headings.reviewNote: Places certificated teachers employed on or after August 28, 2003, for at least seventeen but fewer than twenty hours per week into PSRS with pro rata credit, while granting a ninety-day option to elect PEERS membership.

headings.title: Purchase of post-August 28, 1991 qualifying service under subsection 2
headings.reviewNote: Permits members under subsection 2 to purchase credit in PSRS (under section 169.056) or PEERS (under section 169.655) for post-August 28, 1991 service that would have qualified under subsection 2 before August 28, 2003.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.712 governing PSRS/PEERS membership and 90-day opt-out elections for certificated teachers in noncertificated or 17-to-20-hour positions and purchase of post-1991 prior service.

headings.title: Nomination of successor beneficiary upon divorce or spouse death
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes retirants who elected spousal survivor options to nominate successor spouse beneficiary upon divorce or death.

headings.title: Procedures, filing deadlines, and actuarial adjustment for successor nomination
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 1 successor nominations to follow board procedures, be filed within ninety days of May 6, 1993, or one year of remarriage (whichever is later), and triggers actuarial allowance adjustment.

headings.title: Cancellation of survivor option and benefit restoration upon divorce
headings.reviewNote: Permits retirant to cancel spousal survivor option and pop up to full single-life allowance following divorce.

headings.title: Option 1 pop-up for pre-September 2015 same-sex domestic partner elections
headings.reviewNote: Permits PEERS retirants who on or before September 1, 2015, nominated a same-sex domestic partner under section 169.670(4) to increase to Option 1 upon affidavit of ended partnership, written beneficiary consent or post-September 1, 2023 court order, and dissolution decree if legally married.

headings.title: Successor spouse nomination after death or end of same-sex domestic partner
headings.reviewNote: Permits PEERS retirants who on or before September 1, 2015, nominated a same-sex domestic partner to nominate a spouse upon later marriage following the partner's death or ended partnership/removal (plus dissolution if married).

headings.title: Filing deadlines and actuarial adjustment for subsection 5 nominations
headings.reviewNote: Requires subsection 5 successor nominations to follow board procedures, be filed within one year of September 1, 2023, or one year of marriage (whichever is later), and triggers actuarial allowance adjustment.

headings.title: Statutory definition of same-sex domestic partners
headings.reviewNote: Defines same-sex domestic partners as unrelated adults of the same sex sharing a mutual residence and domestic life.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 editorial headings for 169.715 governing PEERS successor beneficiary nominations, filing deadlines and actuarial adjustments, post-divorce Option 1 pop-up, and same-sex domestic partner pop-up/successor provisions.

headings.title: Indemnification of trustees and employees by retirement systems
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes PSRS and PEERS to indemnify trustees and employees against liabilities and legal defense expenses.

headings.title: Procurement of fiduciary liability insurance policies by board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes board of trustees to obtain and maintain fiduciary liability insurance policies covering trustees and personnel.

headings.title: Fifteen-day written notice requirement for indemnification claims
headings.reviewNote: Conditions indemnification rights upon trustee or employee serving written notice within fifteen days of process.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 editorial headings for 169.750 governing PSRS and PEERS trustee and employee indemnification, insurance/indemnity policies, and fifteen-day written notice requirement.
